description_en: Deletes an export directory of a protocol service
description_zh: 删除一个协议服务导出目录
kebab_example: aliyun nas delete-protocol-mount-target --protocol-service-id ptc-197ed6a00f2b0000 --file-system-id cpfs-099394bd928c0000 --export-id exp-19abf5beab8d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteProtocolMountTarget

parameters.help_en: The ID of the protocol service
parameters.name: protocol_service_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the export directory
parameters.name: export_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同的请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. The dry run checks parameter validity and prerequisites. The dry run does not delete the specified export directory or incur fees.

Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the HTTP status code 200 is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the specified export directory is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次删除请求执行预检。
预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、依赖条件等，并不会实际删除实例，也不会产生费用。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除导出目录。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制依赖条件。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200HttpCode。

false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除实例
parameters.name: dry_run
